PrivacyContent.cape-town-concierge-we-us: Cape Town Concierge (“we”, “us”, “our”) provides luxury chauffeur and private tour services in Cape Town. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect personal information when you engage with us — through our website, WhatsApp, our booking management application, or in person.
PrivacyContent.this-policy-is-intended-t: This policy is intended to comply with the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (POPIA) of South Africa.
PrivacyContent.when-you-book-a-service: When you book a service with us, we collect:
PrivacyContent.trip-dates-times-and-any: Trip dates, times, and any specific requests you share with us
PrivacyContent.we-also-collect-minimal-t: We also collect minimal technical information when you visit our website — anonymous analytics such as page views and device type.
PrivacyContent.we-use-the-information-yo: We use the information you provide to:
PrivacyContent.coordinate-and-deliver-th: Coordinate and deliver the chauffeur or tour service you booked
PrivacyContent.communicate-with-you-abou: Communicate with you about your booking via WhatsApp, phone, or email
PrivacyContent.send-you-a-booking-confir: Send you a booking confirmation with the details of your trip
PrivacyContent.respond-to-enquiries-you-: Respond to enquiries you send us
PrivacyContent.maintain-operational-reco: Maintain operational records of our services
PrivacyContent.3-who-we-share-your: 3. Who we share your information with
PrivacyContent.we-share-your-booking-det: We share your booking details with:
PrivacyContent.the-driver-assigned-to-yo: The driver assigned to your trip — limited to your name, contact number, and pickup location, so they can perform the service
PrivacyContent.payment-processors-e-g-yo: Payment processors (e.g. Yoco) if you pay through a payment link we send you — limited to what is required to process the payment
PrivacyContent.our-hosting-and-infrastru: Our hosting and infrastructure providers (Railway, AWS, Apple, Google) — strictly to operate the service
PrivacyContent.we-do-not-sell-your: We do NOT sell your information to third parties. We do not use it for marketing communications without your consent.
PrivacyContent.we-retain-your-booking-re: We retain your booking records for as long as needed to provide the service, comply with our legal obligations (such as tax records), and resolve any disputes that may arise. You may request deletion of your records at any time, subject to those obligations (see “Your rights” below).
PrivacyContent.under-popia-you-have-the: Under POPIA you have the right to:
PrivacyContent.access-the-personal-infor: Access the personal information we hold about you
PrivacyContent.request-that-we-delete-yo: Request that we delete your information (subject to our legal obligations)
PrivacyContent.object-to-processing-in-c: Object to processing in certain circumstances
PrivacyContent.lodge-a-complaint-with-th: Lodge a complaint with the Information Regulator of South Africa (inforegulator.org.za)
PrivacyContent.to-exercise-any-of-these: To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details at the end of this policy.
PrivacyContent.we-take-reasonable-steps-: We take reasonable steps to protect your information:
PrivacyContent.all-data-is-transmitted-o: All data is transmitted over encrypted (HTTPS) connections
PrivacyContent.access-to-our-operational: Access to our operational systems is restricted to authorised staff
PrivacyContent.we-use-trusted-cloud-prov: We use trusted cloud providers (Railway, AWS) with industry-standard security practices
PrivacyContent.no-online-system-is-perfe: No online system is perfectly secure, but we work to keep your information safe.
PrivacyContent.our-website-uses-minimal-: Our website uses minimal cookies — only those necessary for the site to function plus basic anonymous analytics. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.
PrivacyContent.our-services-are-intended: Our services are intended for adults (18+). We do not knowingly collect information from children. If you believe we have, please contact us and we will delete it.
PrivacyContent.we-may-update-this-policy: We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top reflects the most recent change. We encourage you to review the policy periodically.
PrivacyContent.for-any-privacy-related-q: For any privacy-related question or to exercise your rights, contact:
CancellationPolicyContent.this-policy-ex: This policy explains how cancellations and changes work across the services Cape Town Concierge arranges: private chauffeur hire, day tours, villa and hotel stays, and combined trip packages. It applies to bookings made directly with us via WhatsApp, email, or our website.
CancellationPolicyContent.bookings-for-c: Bookings for chauffeur services and private day tours (Cape Peninsula, Winelands, Table Mountain and similar):
CancellationPolicyContent.free-cancellat: : free cancellation, full refund of any deposit paid.
CancellationPolicyContent.50-of-the-trip: : 50% of the trip fee is due; the balance is refundable.
CancellationPolicyContent.the-full-trip-: : the full trip fee is due. Where possible we'll try to re-book the driver and refund the portion recovered.
: the full trip fee is due and no refund is offered.
CancellationPolicyContent.flight-delays-: Flight delays, medical emergencies, and severe weather are considered on a case-by-case basis and we'll always do what we can to be fair.
CancellationPolicyContent.50-of-the-tran: : 50% of the transfer fee is due.
CancellationPolicyContent.flight-tracked: Flight-tracked airport transfers automatically adjust for delays at no extra cost.
CancellationPolicyContent.accommodation-: Accommodation cancellations follow the individual property's policy, which is confirmed to you in writing when your booking is issued. In most cases:
CancellationPolicyContent.deposit-refund: : deposit refundable less a small admin fee.
CancellationPolicyContent.deposit-is-non: : deposit is non-refundable; balance is refundable.
CancellationPolicyContent.mid-december-t: (mid-December to mid-January and Easter week), stricter terms usually apply. Full details are shared before you confirm.
CancellationPolicyContent.where-a-villa-: Where a villa or hotel is booked through a third party (Nox, direct with the property, an OTA), that provider's cancellation policy takes precedence. We'll always highlight the applicable terms before you confirm.
CancellationPolicyContent.where-a-bookin: Where a booking includes a mix of accommodation, chauffeur, and tour components, each component follows its own policy above. Cancellation of one component does not automatically cancel the others. We'll help you re-plan any remaining components wherever possible.
CancellationPolicyContent.we-ll-always-t: We'll always try to accommodate a date change instead of a cancellation:
CancellationPolicyContent.chauffeur-and-: Chauffeur and tour re-scheduling is free of charge up to 24 hours before the trip, subject to availability.
CancellationPolicyContent.accommodation-: Accommodation date changes are subject to the property's availability and terms. We'll confirm any difference in price and any admin fee before making the change.
CancellationPolicyContent.refunds-are-pr: Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 7 to 14 business days of the cancellation being confirmed. Card refunds may take an additional few days to reflect depending on your issuing bank.
CancellationPolicyContent.on-very-rare-o: On very rare occasions we may need to cancel a booking due to circumstances beyond our control, mechanical failure of the assigned vehicle, driver illness, extreme weather closing a route, or a property withdrawing its availability. In those cases:
CancellationPolicyContent.we-ll-offer-a-: We'll offer a replacement vehicle, driver, or property of equivalent or higher standard where possible.
CancellationPolicyContent.if-no-acceptab: If no acceptable alternative can be arranged, you receive a full refund of any amount paid.
CancellationPolicyContent.8-how-to-cance: 8. How to cancel or change a booking
CancellationPolicyContent.the-fastest-wa: The fastest way to change or cancel a booking is via WhatsApp, which reaches our operations team directly:
CancellationPolicyContent.please-include: Please include your booking reference in the message.
CancellationPolicyContent.we-may-update-: We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top reflects the most recent change. The policy in force at the time your booking is confirmed applies for the duration of that booking.
multiDay.your-chauffeur-is-assigned-for: Your chauffeur is assigned for the stay
multiDay.many-of-our-clients-book: Many of our clients book the same chauffeur for several days. Tell us your dates and what you enjoy, and we'll plan each day, reserve what needs reserving, and handle every journey from arrival to departure.
multiDay.how-many-days-can-i: How many days can I book a chauffeur for?
multiDay.as-many-as-you-like: As many as you like. Most clients book between two days and two weeks, and some keep the same chauffeur for their whole stay. Tell us your dates and we will plan around them.
multiDay.will-i-have-the-same: Will I have the same chauffeur every day?
multiDay.yes-your-chauffeur-is-assigned: Yes. Your chauffeur is assigned for the whole stay, so they learn your preferences, your pace and the plan for each day. If you want a different vehicle on a particular day, we can arrange that.
multiDay.every-day-includes-a-profession: Every day includes a professional chauffeur, your vehicle, fuel and bottled water. Entrance fees, meals and gratuities are not included unless we tell you otherwise in your plan.
multiDay.how-long-is-a-full: How long is a full day?
multiDay.a-full-day-is-up: A full day is up to 8 hours. If you would like more time on a particular day, extra hours are available at an additional rate, which we confirm in your quote.
multiDay.can-you-take-us-to: Can you take us to Hermanus and along the Garden Route?
multiDay.yes-multi-day-trips-can: Yes. Multi-day trips can run from Cape Town and the Winelands to Hermanus and the Garden Route. We plan the routes, the overnight stops and the driving times with you, so each day stays comfortable.
multiDay.message-us-on-whatsapp-or: Message us on WhatsApp or use the enquiry form with your dates, the number of guests and what you enjoy. We reply with a tailored day-by-day plan and quote within 30 minutes.

airport-transfers-cape-town.your-chauffe: Your chauffeur tracks your flight in real time and meets you in the arrivals hall with a name board, no waiting around trying to find your ride.
airport-transfers-cape-town.early-mornin: Early morning, last flight of the night, or anything in between. We operate around the clock for all Cape Town International arrivals and departures.
airport-transfers-cape-town.your-quoted-: Your quoted price covers the vehicle, chauffeur, fuel, parking, and toll fees. What you see is what you pay. No surprises after a long flight.
airport-transfers-cape-town.the-right-ve: The Right Vehicle for Your Group
airport-transfers-cape-town.from-executi: From executive sedans for solo travellers to the 14-seat Mercedes Sprinter for large groups. We match the vehicle to your party size and luggage. Just tell us what you need.
